Query: How does Button Compare to Profound
Response:
1. What each product actually is
Button (usebutton.com)

Button is a mobile commerce + post-click optimization platform.

It focuses on:

Turning ad / affiliate / SMS clicks into higher-converting purchase journeys

Deep linking users into apps instead of web pages

Attribution + revenue optimization for commerce traffic

“Post-tap” optimization (what happens after the click)

Core identity:

A performance marketing infrastructure layer for ecommerce and app-driven revenue.

Typical buyers:

Retailers (e.g., ecommerce brands)

Publishers (affiliate sites, media companies)

Mobile app growth teams

Profound (tryprofound.com)

Profound is an AI search / GEO / AEO optimization platform.

It focuses on:

Tracking how brands appear inside LLM answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)

Measuring “AI visibility” and prompt-based demand

Optimizing content for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

Detecting citation gaps and competitor presence in AI responses

Core identity:

A visibility + optimization layer for AI-native search engines

Typical buyers:

Enterprise marketing teams

SEO / content / growth teams

Brands optimizing for AI discovery rather than Google rankings

2. Key difference (simplified)
Dimension	Button	Profound
Primary problem	Converting clicks into revenue	Getting cited in AI answers
Stage of funnel	Post-click / conversion	Pre-click / discovery
Core system	Commerce routing + attribution	AI visibility + content intelligence
Optimization target	Purchases, installs, LTV	Mentions, citations, share of AI voice
“Search” type	Behavioral (click → buy)	Cognitive (prompt → answer)
Output metric	Revenue per tap / conversion lift	AI visibility score / mention share
3. How they sit in the modern marketing stack
Button sits in:

Performance + conversion infrastructure

Paid traffic optimization

Affiliate monetization

App install / ecommerce conversion systems

Attribution + routing intelligence

Think:

“You already got the user — now make the journey convert better.”

Profound sits in:

AI discovery + visibility infrastructure (GEO/AEO layer)

Monitoring what LLMs say about your brand

Influencing how AI systems cite you

Optimizing content for inclusion in AI-generated answers

Think:

“Before the click exists — make sure the AI even mentions you.”

4. Where they overlap (but don’t compete directly)

There is a narrow overlap in commerce intelligence, but they operate at different layers:

Shared themes:

Data-driven marketing optimization

Enterprise GTM tooling

Revenue impact focus

Heavy analytics orientation

But fundamentally different levers:

Button → improves conversion efficiency of existing traffic

Profound → improves probability of being discovered via AI systems

5. Strategic interpretation (why both exist now)

The separation reflects a broader shift:

Old world: “win Google rankings → get clicks → optimize conversion”

New world:

Profound: “win AI mention → become part of answer set”

Button: “once traffic arrives → maximize monetization”

So they map to two halves of the funnel:

Profound = demand creation in AI search

Button = demand capture optimization after arrival

6. When you’d pick one over the other
Choose Button if:

You run ecommerce or mobile apps

You care about ROAS, conversion lift, affiliate revenue

You already have traffic and want better monetization

Choose Profound if:

You care about brand visibility inside ChatGPT / Perplexity / Gemini

You’re shifting SEO strategy toward AI search

You need GEO/AEO insights and content gaps

Bottom line

Button = revenue optimization engine for traffic you already have

Profound = visibility optimization system for traffic you want to appear in AI-generated discovery

They are not direct competitors; they operate in different layers of the modern marketing funnel, which is increasingly split between AI-driven discovery (Profound) and post-click monetization (Button).
